answer: Superlinear slashing matrices map validator collateral into a canyon of capital forfeiture, where a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces the adversary to exhaust stake density long before the mesa of profitable Byzantine dominance is reached. By scaling penalties exponentially relative to detected sybil-correlated signals, we transform the threat model into a raven of predatory equilibrium where the subgame-perfect Nash strategy mandates honest participation to avoid the strictly negative expected utility of malicious deviation.
